summary: Tiny 9 m kerb on a steep corner, ringed by houses.

drivers.seclusion: Dense houses within 12-24 m on all sides; a person stands on the verge.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 9 m of kerb, shorter than a van, next to the junction.
drivers.convention: A car is parked near the start; no signs.

flags: Steep: about 14% grade, over the 12% limit
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the verge on the south side.
